profile.headline: Full-stack software engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a self-taught software engineer with an unconventional background in architecture & urban planning! 

My earlier work experience centered geospatial data analysis and visualization, and user experience design. Nowadays, I'm a senior software engineer with 10+ years of full-stack web application experience across UI design, front-end UI engineering, backend engineering, and even infrastructure development.

I've been called the "Queen of Style" because I can fix any CSS problem.

projects.title: MBTA.com
projects.description:
MBTA.com is the authoritative source of transit system information for the Greater Boston area, serving nearly 200 cities and towns and over 1 million daily riders on the subway, bus, ferry, and commuter rail. The website has 500k+ weekday page views from a wide section of the public, and serves a variety of needs. 

As tech lead, I manage development of this large Phoenix application hosted on AWS, with an Elixir backend, partial React frontend, and connected services -- the Drupal content management system, our OpenTripPlanner instance, an AWS Simple Email Service automation to deliver customer feedback to our ticketing system, and more.
